resumeText:
Sneha Iyer
Chennai, Tamil Nadu | sneha.iyer@example.com

Underwriting Executive - Retail Health, Suraksha Health Insurance Ltd, Chennai (Aug 2022 - Present)
- Took underwriting decisions to accept, load, exclude or decline about 40 retail health proposals a day
- Reviewed proposal forms, pre-policy medical check-up reports and hospitalisation history for applicants above 45
- Applied premium loading for diabetes and hypertension as per the insurer's rating grid
- Ensured every decision followed IRDAI guidelines and the board approved underwriting policy
- Maintained the daily underwriting turnaround MIS in MS Excel for the underwriting head

Medical Officer, Arogya Multispeciality Clinic, Chennai (Jul 2021 - Jul 2022)
- Handled outpatient consultations and patient records

Education: BAMS. Licentiate, Insurance Institute of India.
Skills: Policy wordings, Underwriting workflow system
